default.title: OAuth 2.0 / JWT Auth Flow
default.code:
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  actor User
  participant Client as Web App
  participant Auth as Auth Server
  participant API as Resource API

  User->>Client: Click Login
  Client->>Auth: Request Auth Code (/oauth/authorize)
  Auth-->>User: Present Login & Consent Screen
  User->>Auth: Submit Credentials
  Auth-->>Client: Return Auth Code in Redirect
  Client->>Auth: Exchange Code for Access Token (POST /token)
  Auth-->>Client: Return JWT Access & Refresh Token
  Client->>API: Request Protected Data (Bearer Token)
  API-->>Client: Return JSON Payload
  Client-->>User: Render Dashboard

payment.title: Payment Processing Flow
payment.code:
sequenceDiagram
  actor Customer
  participant Shop as Storefront App
  participant Engine as Checkout Engine
  participant Stripe as Stripe Gateway
  
  Customer->>Shop: Click Checkout
  Shop->>Engine: Create Payment Intent
  Engine->>Stripe: Init Intent ($89.00)
  Stripe-->>Engine: Client Secret
  Engine-->>Shop: Pass Client Secret
  Shop->>Customer: Render Card Element
  Customer->>Stripe: Confirm Card Details Direct
  Stripe-->>Engine: Webhook: payment_intent.succeeded
  Engine->>Shop: Mark Order Paid
  Shop-->>Customer: Display Order Confirmation

default.title: Order Lifecycle State Machine
default.code:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> PendingPayment
  PendingPayment --> Processing : Payment Verified
  PendingPayment --> Cancelled : Payment Failed / Timeout
  
  state Processing {
    [*] --> Packaging
    Packaging --> QualityCheck
    QualityCheck --> ReadyForDispatch
  }
  
  Processing --> Shipped : Carrier Picked Up
  Shipped --> OutForDelivery : Local Hub
  OutForDelivery --> Delivered : Customer Signed
  Delivered --> [*]
  Cancelled --> [*]

      S3[(S3 Object Storage)]
    end
  end

  CloudFront --> WAF
  WAF --> ALB
  ALB --> Pod1
  ALB --> Pod2
  Pod2 --> Pod3
  Pod2 --> Aurora
